Subject: Final commit sweep + invoice gating for June bookings

Diego —

Quick note to align on the PO / invoice timing so we can recognize the June bookings in this month's close. We have a short window: finance needs a valid PO reference and either a supplier invoice or AP confirmation by EOD Friday (June 18) to include the seats/usage against June bookings.

Attached is a proposed cutoff calendar (June_invoice_cutoff_calendar.csv) and a short checklist below. Can you confirm whether Stellar will:

- Share a signed PO or PO number that references RDW-4721 by EOD 6/18
- Accept a pro-forma invoice from Redwood with final invoice to follow on 7/01 if PO shows the committed amount

If you need a different cadence, tell us and we'll flag the recognition change with Finance. We're trying to avoid a booking slip into July.

Next steps:
1) Reply with PO number / any AP contact (if different than Kelsey)
2) Ben will send the pro-forma invoice template if you want that route
3) We'll upload PO to the shared drive and confirm the cut in our close tracker

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround here.

—Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0124

Aditya —

Thanks for the note. A couple quick questions so we can confirm on our side:

1) Does the PO need to be fully executed (signed PDF) or is a PO number issued by our procurement system sufficient for your finance team to proceed?
2) If we accept a pro-forma invoice now, what is the exact field Redwood finance needs on the final invoice to tie the payment back to the June booking? (PO number, contract ref, deal id?)

We can likely get a PO number out by EOD 6/18. Kelsey (AP) is CC'd — Kelsey, do you want us to route the signed PDF to aditya.rao@redwood.ai or to finance@redwood.ai?

Looping in a suggested gating workflow from Finance so we can be prescriptive to Stellar:

Checklist (recommended) — Redwood -> Stellar
- PO number assigned by Stellar (ok if not fully signed PDF) by EOD 6/18 — required field: PO Number
- Redwood sends pro-forma invoice referencing: PO Number, Deal ID RDW-4721, Customer Contract # CH-9912
- AP confirms receipt (accounts-payable@stellarhealth.com) — confirm by reply to thread
- Final tax invoice to be issued 7/01 with the same PO Number for payment processing

Notes:
- Finance confirms that a PO number is acceptable to lock the recognition as long as the pro-forma invoice references the same PO number and deal id; signed PDFs are preferred but not strictly required for month-end recognition.
- If Stellar can provide a signed PO earlier, we will upload the PDF to the finance shared drive (link to FIN-324 ticket).

I'll prepare the pro-forma invoice template and attach it to the thread. If anyone wants to tweak the template fields, flag now.

—Ben

Appreciate the quick responses — pulling the plan together below and locking the timeline: 

Final agreed workflow:
- Stellar to provide PO number by EOD Friday, 6/18 (PO number acceptable for Finance)
- Redwood to send pro-forma now and final invoice on 7/01 referencing PO Number + RDW-4721
- Kelsey to confirm receipt to this thread once PO number is issued

Diego — if you send the PO number here or to accounts-payable@stellarhealth.com we'll attach and mark the booking for June recognition. I've created FIN ticket FIN-324 and uploaded the cutoff calendar + PO stub to the drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDEf

If no PO number is received by EOD 6/18 we will have to move the recognition to July close and update forecasts accordingly. Please confirm.

Thanks all —
Aditya
